licence.basis: The preserved item names the King Fahd Glorious Quran Printing Complex as publisher and rights holder and points at the Complex's own public rights notice. The notice itself could not be read today because the official server timed out.
licence.revalidationRule: When dm.qurancomplex.gov.sa is reachable again, re-read the rights page and either replace this source with the official package or hash-compare the official package against fileSha256 above, before any release.

extraction.method: Direct read of the PDF page image XObjects. No OCR, no screenshot, no re-render, no upscaling.
extraction.offsetProof: PDF page labels start decimal numbering at PDF index 4. Verified visually against the printed folio numbers: PDF index 6 prints 3, index 7 prints 4, index 79 prints 76, index 80 prints 77, index 81 prints 78. Printed pages 1 and 2 are the ornate opening pages and carry no printed folio number in this edition, so page 1 was confirmed by content (Surat al-Fatihah in the ornate opening frame) and by its numbered neighbours.
extraction.sourcePageSize: 957x1368 px for every page in the package (MediaBox 717.75 x 1026 pt)

whiteMarginTreatment.rule: Crop contiguous exterior near-white pixels only. Keep the union bounding box of every non-white printed element, then expand it by a safety margin.
whiteMarginTreatment.verification: inkPixelsDiscarded counts every pixel outside the crop rectangle that is not near-white. It is 0 for both pages, so no printed pixel was removed.

pages.printedPageNumberNote: The ornate opening page of this edition carries no printed folio number. Identity confirmed by content and by the numbered neighbouring pages.
pages.format: WebP, lossless (RIFF chunks VP8X, ICCP, VP8L)
pages.losslessProof: Round-tripped in the encoder: the decoded WebP was compared with the source pixels sample by sample. 0 differing samples, worst channel delta 0.

pages.printedPageNumberNote: The printed folio number for page 77 is visible at the foot of the page and was read before the page was accepted.
